description: A network of snowmobile trails in the Sheridan Lake area. The trails mainly follow old logging roads and skid trails and range from easy to difficult.
directions: From 100 Mile House, head south on Hwy 97 for 9km to the Interlakes Hwy turnoff. Turn east onto Hwy 24 and follow the Hwy for 26 km. Turn south onto Sheridan Lake Road W and travel 6km. Turn west onto Boulanger Rd and follow approximately 1km to the trailhead.

stats.Recreation District: Rec Dist - South Cariboo - Chilcotin - Central Coast

title: Interlakes Snowmobile
